svg.title: マデイラ諸島の旅の地図
svg.desc: マデイラ島、ポルト・サント島、デザルタス諸島の実際の海岸線と8景の位置。セルヴァージェンシュ諸島は実海岸線を別枠で表示。
svg.metadata: Target land: GSHHG/GSHHS full-resolution shoreline via Basemap 2.0.0 (Paul Wessel and Walter H. F. Smith; https://www.soest.hawaii.edu/wessel/gshhg/), assigned with Natural Earth 1:10m Admin-0 map subunits ca96624a56bd078437bca8184e78163e5039ad19 (public domain) unit PMD (Madeira); internal land boundaries follow Natural Earth. Surrounding land: the same GSHHG shoreline, drawn to the canvas edge. WGS84; local-equirectangular-fit-v1, 1200x760. Selvagens: same GSHHG shoreline in a separate frame (not to position or scale).
